* These statements were validated using Carestream CsI detectors in reader studies conducted by
board-certified radiologists. Pairwise comparisons were performed between images at nominal exposure
dose without SNC and at 50% reduced dose with SNC. The reduced-dose images included live patient
images with simulated dose reduction, as well as images of human cadavers and anthropomorphic
phantoms obtained using actual reduced-dose X-ray exposures. SNC performance was further confirmed
using a CDRAD phantom. IEC EI values on average at nominal and reduced dose were 220 and 110,
respectively.

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

## See through to the future.

 

Radiology is always advancing, driven every day by new demands, challenges, and possibilities. And
with every advancement radiology makes, Agfa takes it further. So when radiology teams are asked to
do more, faster, with fewer resources — all while delivering the highest diagnostic quality — they
have what they need: Clarity. Perspective. And confidence in what comes next.

 

Each week, more than 3 million radiographic exams are carried out with Agfa technology worldwide. We
make each one count by combining intelligent automation, streamlined workflows and seamless
integration. The right information is available precisely when it’s needed. Radiology doesn’t pause.
Neither do we. See Through to the Future.

### How our technologies make the difference …

[
][106]
[

#### **MUSICA™**: Gold standard image processing

][107]

**MUSICA™** automatically analyzes the characteristics of each raw image and optimizes the
processing parameters, independent of body part or dose deviation. It enhances noise suppression,
offers superb brightness control, reduces veiling glare, and plays a significant role in enabling
potential dose reduction. The result is excellent image quality compared to standard image
processing, representing bone and soft issue in a balanced way.

[Learn more ][108]
[
][109]
[

#### **SmartXR™**: The intelligent radiography workflow assistant

][110]

The **SmartXR™** portfolio offers digital radiography tools for dose, alignment, patient
positioning, image rotation and more. These provide the radiographer with predictive workflow
assistance that helps improve operational performance in image acquisition.

[Learn more ][111]
[
][112]
[

#### **SupportXR™**: DR Service, by Agfa Experts

][113]

Downtime means disruption. Prevention is the best protection. And with the right service plan in
place, you can ensure fast, reliable recovery, keeping operations running smoothly – even in the
face of unexpected events.

[Learn more ][114]
[
][115]
[

#### **ScanXR™**: Early notification of pathologies and diseases

][116]

By identifying suspicious critical pathologies and diseases, **CriticalScan™** ensures that images
with key diagnostic information can be immediately marked as high priority at the point of care.
Enhanced pathology visualization enables fast and improved patient outcomes.

**DensityScan™** enables earlier identification of patients with a high risk of osteoporosis, during
ordinary X-ray imaging. It helps bridge the diagnosis gap for osteoporosis: to improve patients’
quality of life, ensure healthcare equity, and enable significant healthcare cost savings.

[Learn more ][117]

## See through to the future.

 

Radiology is always advancing, driven every day by new demands, challenges, and possibilities. And
with every advancement radiology makes, Agfa takes it further. So when radiology teams are asked to
do more, faster, with fewer resources — all while delivering the highest diagnostic quality — they
have what they need: Clarity. Perspective. And confidence in what comes next.

 

Each week, more than 3 million radiographic exams are carried out with Agfa technology worldwide. We
make each one count by combining intelligent automation, streamlined workflows and seamless
integration. The right information is available precisely when it’s needed. Radiology doesn’t pause.
Neither do we. See Through to the Future.

### How our technologies make the difference …

[
][106]
[

#### **MUSICA™**: Gold standard image processing

][107]

**MUSICA™** automatically analyzes the characteristics of each raw image and optimizes the
processing parameters, independent of body part or dose deviation. It enhances noise suppression,
offers superb brightness control, reduces veiling glare, and plays a significant role in enabling
potential dose reduction. The result is excellent image quality compared to standard image
processing, representing bone and soft issue in a balanced way.

[Learn more ][108]
[
][109]
[

#### **SmartXR™**: The intelligent radiography workflow assistant

][110]

The **SmartXR™** portfolio offers digital radiography tools for dose, alignment, patient
positioning, image rotation and more. These provide the radiographer with predictive workflow
assistance that helps improve operational performance in image acquisition.

[Learn more ][111]
[
][112]
[

#### **SupportXR™**: DR Service, by Agfa Experts

][113]

Downtime means disruption. Prevention is the best protection. And with the right service plan in
place, you can ensure fast, reliable recovery, keeping operations running smoothly – even in the
face of unexpected events.

[Learn more ][114]
[
][115]
[

#### **ScanXR™**: Early notification of pathologies and diseases

][116]

By identifying suspicious critical pathologies and diseases, **CriticalScan™** ensures that images
with key diagnostic information can be immediately marked as high priority at the point of care.
Enhanced pathology visualization enables fast and improved patient outcomes.

**DensityScan™** enables earlier identification of patients with a high risk of osteoporosis, during
ordinary X-ray imaging. It helps bridge the diagnosis gap for osteoporosis: to improve patients’
quality of life, ensure healthcare equity, and enable significant healthcare cost savings.

[Learn more ][117]

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

### New features, built for speed

## Trusted by more than 100,000 of the world’s leading organizations

## Calendly makes scheduling simple

Calendly’s easy enough for individual users, and powerful enough to meet the needs of enterprise
organizations — including 86% of the Fortune 500 companies.

[Sign up for free][45]

### Connect your calendars

Calendly connects up to six calendars to automate scheduling with real-time availability.

### Add your availability

Keep invitees informed of your availability. Take control of your calendar with detailed
availability settings, scheduling rules, buffers, and more.

### Connect conferencing tools

Sync your video conferencing tools and set preferences for in-person meetings or calls.

### Customize your event types

Choose from pre-built templates or quickly create custom event types for any meeting you need to
schedule.

### Share your scheduling link

Easily book meetings by embedding scheduling links on your website, landing pages, or emails.

organizations — including 86% of the Fortune 500 companies.

[Sign up for free][45]

### Connect your calendars

Calendly connects up to six calendars to automate scheduling with real-time availability.

### Add your availability

Keep invitees informed of your availability. Take control of your calendar with detailed
availability settings, scheduling rules, buffers, and more.

### Connect conferencing tools

Sync your video conferencing tools and set preferences for in-person meetings or calls.

### Customize your event types

Choose from pre-built templates or quickly create custom event types for any meeting you need to
schedule.

### Share your scheduling link

Easily book meetings by embedding scheduling links on your website, landing pages, or emails.

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

Fitness at your fingertips
On mobile or web, Garmin Connect is the tool for tracking, analyzing and sharing health and fitness
activities from your Garmin device.
[

Explore

][5]
How it works

Install Garmin Connect on your phone

Get active with your Garmin device

View your progress in Garmin Connect

Your day at a glance
Garmin Connect displays your vital health data and entries for easy viewing. Customize what you want
to see, in the order you want to see it.You'll receive more detailed analysis, as well. View weekly,
monthly and yearly averages of health stats, historic tracking of your favorites activities and
more.
Beat Yesterday
Garmin Connect gives you all the tools you need to take your training to the next level. With Garmin
Coach, you get customized workouts that adapt to your ability, personalized coaching advice and
helpful articles and videos.
[Explore Garmin Coach][6]
Track your activities
Whether you run, swim, kayak or lift weights... whatever you do, Garmin Connect can track it. The
statistics recorded during each activity let you analyze your performance and improve on it next
time.
Connect with Friends
Garmin Connect is better with friends. You can compete in step and distance challenges, create
groups or cheer each other on with likes and comments. Our badge feature lets you earn badges for
accomplishments and compare them with your friends.
[Made for your Garmin device]
Made for your Garmin device
Garmin Connect is an extension of your Garmin device. Whatever your style or activity preferences,
we have an option for you.

within the El Paso, San Antonio, Laredo, Houston and more, soon to be available in the New Mexico
region. What started off as a small Radiology Mobile has since grown into a mobile and Out patient
Imaging center that is operated 24/7 on-site for Anyone, Anywhere, at Anytime. Our team consist of

Mobile Imaging, we strive to provide the best for our clients with fast turnaround times. We offer
patients and providers all the attention and care they deserve in order to get their exam results in
no time. We specialize in all specialties in medicine for Out patient Imaging Center and Mobile

## Gastroenterology, Liver Care & Preventive Screening Services

We provide expert diagnosis and treatment for a wide range of digestive conditions, including acid
reflux (GERD), IBS, liver disease, and more-using advanced procedures and personalized care plans
tailored to your needs.

[Gastrointestinal Consultations]

### Digestive Symptoms

Explore acid reflux, bloating, abdominal pain, bowel habit changes, constipation, and swallowing
problems with guidance on when to see a GI specialist.

[View Digestive Symptoms][73]
[Hepatology & Liver Care]

### Digestive & Liver Conditions

Learn about fatty liver disease, hepatitis, cirrhosis, abnormal liver tests, and liver-related
concerns with advanced evaluation and care guidance.

[View Liver Conditions][74]
[Endoscopy Services]

### GI Procedures

View colonoscopy, upper endoscopy, and related GI procedures used to screen, diagnose, and evaluate
digestive conditions with specialist guidance.

[View Procedures][75]

## About Us

### Our Mission

Digestive health affects your sleep, work, eating and living habits – when it doesn't feel good, you
need answers from experts who get them. Our board-certified gastroenterologists at GastroDoxs have
more than 20 years of clinical experience and care for every patient who enters our practice. No
more the ‘revolving door’ practice. We listen before we prescribe, explain before we act and build
treatment plans around your life.

Whether it's a routine colonoscopy screening, liver disease or anything in between, we provide
comprehensive diagnostic, procedural, and preventative care all over Houston. We achieve these with
cutting-edge technology, which allows us to reach a diagnosis as soon as possible, and thus to
shorten the time in which you have to deal with uncertainty.

It's not only what we treat, it's how we treat you. We feel that the best results are achieved when
you feel included, respected and informed. This is the standard we uphold us — and why thousands of
Houston families entrust us with their digestive health year after year.

## See the world of trade like never before

### —gain the insights your business needs

Every day, businesses, analysts, and policymakers turn to ImportGenius to uncover hidden patterns in
global trade. From tracking forced labor and sanctions compliance to monitoring illegal shipments,
our platform helps uncover the unseen and the urgent. We also support [major media outlets][46] in
breaking some of the world’s most impactful trade stories.

But it’s not just about investigations. Logistics companies and customs brokers rely on us to find
new shippers, while importers and exporters use our platform to discover new suppliers, competitive
shifts, and untapped business opportunities.

With ImportGenius, you don’t just react to market changes—you stay ahead of them.

radiologiche all’avanguardia, combinando quotidianamente esperienza e aggiornamento tecnologico.

Il reparto Produzione realizza le apparecchiature radiologiche Italray grazie a processi
automatizzati e a fasi di lavorazione altamente rintracciabili.

#### **Vendita e spedizione**

Una solida rete commerciale supporta e parla di Italray in ogni parte del mondo.

#### **Installazione**

Tecnici altamente qualificati gestiscono e mettono a punto le installazioni delle apparecchiature
radiologiche Italray dal loro posizionamento fino alla fase di collaudo.

#### **Assistenza tecnica**

Tutta la competenza del Servizio di Assistenza a disposizione in ogni momento con la sua esperienza
per consulenza, supporto, interventi rapidi a garanzia della continua funzionalità delle
apparecchiature radiologiche Italray nel mondo.

Sick of waiting on the phone to request an x-ray or taking down lost reports? When you need fast,

## Fast, Accurate Imaging—Delivered Directly to Your Providers

National Mobile X-Ray brings high-quality diagnostic imaging services—X-rays, ultrasounds, and
EKGs—directly to skilled nursing facilities, hospice centers, and homebound patients. By eliminating
the need for patient transport, we help providers reduce risk, accelerate diagnoses, and improve
continuity of care—all while saving time and cost.
* * #### Accurate Diagnostic Results You Can Trust
    
    National Mobile X-Ray delivers fast, high-quality imaging results interpreted by board-certified
    radiologists. With advanced digital technology and AI-enhanced accuracy, we provide the
    dependable diagnostic insights your care team needs—right when you need them.
  * #### Seamless EMR Integration and Connectivity
    
    National Mobile X-Ray connects directly with your facility’s EMR system for fast, secure
    transmission of orders, images, and reports. Our bi-directional integration streamlines
    documentation, reduces errors, and enhances continuity of care across all patient touchpoints.
  * #### Nationwide Mobile Imaging Coverage
    
    National Mobile X-Ray provides high-quality mobile X-ray, ultrasound, and EKG services across
    the U.S. Through our trusted partner network and dedicated regional teams, we deliver
    consistent, dependable diagnostic care—wherever your patients are located.

[Fast, Reliable Diagnostic Workflow][24]

## A Process Designed for Speed, Accuracy, and Reliability

Streamlined Workflows. Trusted Results. Seamless Experience.

From the moment you place an order to the delivery of diagnostic results, our process is built for
efficiency. With smart routing, rapid image transmission, and seamless EMR integration, we ensure
fast turnaround times without compromising quality—keeping your facility running smoothly and your
patients well cared for.
* ### Easy On-Demand Scheduling
  
  Quickly request imaging through our secure portal, phone, fax, 24/7 call center, or directly from
  your EMR. No delays, no complex steps—just fast, reliable access.
  [Schedule mobile X-ray exam via smartphone app for convenient imaging appointment at your
  location.]
* ### Rapid Dispatch and Smart Routing
  
  Our intelligent dispatch system locates the nearest available technologist to reduce travel time
  and deliver prompt, efficient care.
  [Mobile X-ray service scheduling and route mapping for healthcare providers, featuring a digital
  task list and geographic coverage.]
* ### Certified Mobile Imaging Exams
  
  [Licensed technologists][25] perform high-quality x-rays, ultrasounds, and EKGs on-site using
  advanced, state-of-the-art portable equipment.
  [Mobile x-ray services for home healthcare, providing high-quality diagnostic imaging at patients'
  residences. Skilled technicians deliver convenient, reliable portable X-ray exams for elderly or
  immobile patients.]
* ### Instant Image Upload and Interpretation
  
  Completed exams are uploaded instantly to our board-certified radiologists for fast, accurate
  readings and diagnostic turnaround.
  [High-quality chest X-ray displayed on a laptop screen for remote medical diagnosis, emphasizing
  mobile X-ray services, digital imaging, and telemedicine support by National Mobile X-Ray.]
* ### Seamless EMR Integration
  
  Finalized reports are securely delivered and integrated into your EMR, with images linked,
  ensuring smooth communication and minimal effort.
  [Mobile X-ray medical imaging software displaying patient health records and appointment details
  on a computer screen.]

## Partner with a Trusted Mobile Imaging Provider

Contact National Mobile X-Ray for Fast, Reliable On-Site Diagnostic Services

Whether you’re ready to streamline imaging at your facility or have questions about our mobile
X-ray, ultrasound, or EKG services, our team is here to help. Fill out the form and connect with the
experts in mobile diagnostic care.

## Join the Leader in Mobile Diagnostic Imaging

We’re looking for dedicated professionals to help deliver exceptional mobile X-ray, ultrasound, and
EKG services nationwide. Explore rewarding career opportunities and become part of a mission-driven
team that’s transforming patient care.

[Join the Team!][26]
[[National Mobile X-Ray]][27]

ultrasound, and EKG services to skilled nursing, assisted living, hospice, and home health providers

## Fast, Accurate Imaging—Delivered Directly to Your Providers

National Mobile X-Ray brings high-quality diagnostic imaging services—X-rays, ultrasounds, and
EKGs—directly to skilled nursing facilities, hospice centers, and homebound patients. By eliminating
the need for patient transport, we help providers reduce risk, accelerate diagnoses, and improve
continuity of care—all while saving time and cost.
* * #### Accurate Diagnostic Results You Can Trust
    
    National Mobile X-Ray delivers fast, high-quality imaging results interpreted by board-certified
    radiologists. With advanced digital technology and AI-enhanced accuracy, we provide the
    dependable diagnostic insights your care team needs—right when you need them.
  * #### Seamless EMR Integration and Connectivity
    
    National Mobile X-Ray connects directly with your facility’s EMR system for fast, secure
    transmission of orders, images, and reports. Our bi-directional integration streamlines
    documentation, reduces errors, and enhances continuity of care across all patient touchpoints.
  * #### Nationwide Mobile Imaging Coverage
    
    National Mobile X-Ray provides high-quality mobile X-ray, ultrasound, and EKG services across
    the U.S. Through our trusted partner network and dedicated regional teams, we deliver
    consistent, dependable diagnostic care—wherever your patients are located.

[Fast, Reliable Diagnostic Workflow][24]

## A Process Designed for Speed, Accuracy, and Reliability

Streamlined Workflows. Trusted Results. Seamless Experience.

From the moment you place an order to the delivery of diagnostic results, our process is built for
efficiency. With smart routing, rapid image transmission, and seamless EMR integration, we ensure
fast turnaround times without compromising quality—keeping your facility running smoothly and your
patients well cared for.
* ### Easy On-Demand Scheduling
  
  Quickly request imaging through our secure portal, phone, fax, 24/7 call center, or directly from
  your EMR. No delays, no complex steps—just fast, reliable access.
  [Schedule mobile X-ray exam via smartphone app for convenient imaging appointment at your
  location.]
* ### Rapid Dispatch and Smart Routing
  
  Our intelligent dispatch system locates the nearest available technologist to reduce travel time
  and deliver prompt, efficient care.
  [Mobile X-ray service scheduling and route mapping for healthcare providers, featuring a digital
  task list and geographic coverage.]
* ### Certified Mobile Imaging Exams
  
  [Licensed technologists][25] perform high-quality x-rays, ultrasounds, and EKGs on-site using
  advanced, state-of-the-art portable equipment.
  [Mobile x-ray services for home healthcare, providing high-quality diagnostic imaging at patients'
  residences. Skilled technicians deliver convenient, reliable portable X-ray exams for elderly or
  immobile patients.]
* ### Instant Image Upload and Interpretation
  
  Completed exams are uploaded instantly to our board-certified radiologists for fast, accurate
  readings and diagnostic turnaround.
  [High-quality chest X-ray displayed on a laptop screen for remote medical diagnosis, emphasizing
  mobile X-ray services, digital imaging, and telemedicine support by National Mobile X-Ray.]
* ### Seamless EMR Integration
  
  Finalized reports are securely delivered and integrated into your EMR, with images linked,
  ensuring smooth communication and minimal effort.
  [Mobile X-ray medical imaging software displaying patient health records and appointment details
  on a computer screen.]

## Partner with a Trusted Mobile Imaging Provider

X-ray, ultrasound, or EKG services, our team is here to help. Fill out the form and connect with the

We’re looking for dedicated professionals to help deliver exceptional mobile X-ray, ultrasound, and
EKG services nationwide. Explore rewarding career opportunities and become part of a mission-driven
team that’s transforming patient care.

# Park. Pay. Go.

Easily find and pay for parking without running back to feed the meter, or reserve stress-free
parking in advance, all on the free ParkMobile app.

[Download app][3]

## The smarter way to park

ParkMobile puts the power to park in your hands. Whether you're looking for a spot now or reserving
a spot for later, ParkMobile has you covered.

## Better parking for your business

Simplify how your company manages parking. ParkMobile for Business helps you handle vehicles and
users, track expenses, and pull detailed monthly reports from one easy-to-use portal.

### Cut parking admin time

Manage all vehicles and users from one account, avoiding multiple logins and manual processes.

### Keep costs under control

Get clear monthly statements and detailed reporting to track spending and spot savings.

### Park anywhere, anytime

Access over 700 locations nationwide so your team can always find a spot.

## FAQs
* ### What happens if I switch plans mid-cycle?
  
  You can switch between different types of mobile plans, like talk and text plans or data plans.
  Here's what you need to know:
  * You can only make one plan change at a time. If you need to change your start date, you'll have
    to do a separate request.
  * You can start your new plan right away or wait until your next billing cycle.
  * You don't need money in your account to change plans, but you won't be able to use your service
    if your account is unpaid.
  * Your plan change will be recorded in your account automatically.
  * If you switch to a plan that doesn't work with your data storage, you'll see warnings about
    losing that saved data.
* ### Can I bring my own phone to use with T-Mobile Prepaid?
  
  Yes, devices must be unlocked by the original carrier or OEM and be compatible with the network
  for them to be used on T-Mobile's network. Some T-Mobile services may not be available or may
  require additional set up to function properly.
  More info here: [https://prepaid.t-mobile.com/bring-your-own-device][56]
* ### Is mobile hotspot included or available as an add-on?
  
  You're able to utilize hotspot functionality included in your current plan at no extra cost! If
  you exceed your data limit, your data speeds will be reduced to 3G speeds. To access more data,
  you can upgrade your plan by contacting 611 or visiting a T-Mobile store.
* ### What if I’m calling Mexico or Canada exclusively?
  
  With the $5 Mexico & Canada Unlimited Calling & Texting you get unlimited calling to and from the
  U.S., Mexico and Canada while on our network or roaming with a partner. Plus get unlimited texting
  to 215+ countries and destinations, and up to 5GB of high-speed data (or a maximum of your plan’s
  high-speed data allotment, whichever comes first) while in a coverage area in Mexico or Canada.
  The More Monthly plan includes Unlimited talk and text to Mexico & Canada from the U.S., Mexico,
  and Canada, and Unlimited text to 215+ countries and destinations from the U.S.
* ### How will I be charged for international calling to pay-per-minute countries?
  
  All international service charges for calls to pay-per-minute countries will be deducted from your
  available account balance. You will need to have funds in your account in order to complete
  pay-per-minute calls.****
* ### Who is eligible for Caller ID?
  
  All T-Mobile prepaid customers with a capable device on voice plans are eligible for free Caller
  ID.
* ### How much does Caller ID cost?
  
  Caller ID is available to T-Mobile prepaid voice customers at no extra charge.
* ### How do I get Scam ID?
  
  Scam ID is free and automatic for all T-Mobile prepaid customers on a capable device; no action
  required.
* ### How do I activate a T-Mobile Prepaid SIM card?
  
  For detail step by step click here:
  
  [https://www.t-mobile.com/support/devices/sim-esim][57]
* ### Do you offer scam blocking?
  
  T-Mobile Prepaid customers get some of the Scam Shield Un-carrier benefits with Scam ID and Scam
  Block services and free incoming Caller ID.
  Scam ID identifies bad actors and shows as Scam Likely on devices, but it doesn't show blocked or
  unknown caller details.
  All calls from identified scammers (such as Scam Likely numbers) are blocked in the network and
  disconnected before your phone rings when Scam Block is enabled.
* ### What international benefits do I get when I have an international add-on?
  
  The $15 North America Stateside International add-on lets customers on our network unlimited calls
  from the US, Mexico, or Canada to landlines in 70+ countries and destinations, and mobile lines in
  30+ countries and destinations. Plus, get unlimited texting from our network to 215+ countries and
  destinations, and discounted calling to the rest of the world
* ### How do I know the calling and texting rates for countries?
  
  Use the country look-up on T-Mobile.com [link:
  [https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/international-calling][58]] to confirm the per-minute charge
  for the country you want to call and to see if it is one of the 215+ countries and destinations
  that can receive unlimited texts as a part of an international add-on.
* ### What is Caller ID?
  
  Caller ID is a free tool at T-Mobile that displays a caller’s name and number—even if they're not
  in your contact list.
* ### How do I get free Caller ID?
  
  It’s easy! Just visit a Retail store or simply dial #436# from your T-Mobile phone, and we’ll hook
  you up with free Caller ID. To check whether Caller ID is on or off, dial #432#.
* ### What is Scam ID/Scam Block and how does it work on T-Mobile prepaid?
  
  Scam ID and Scam Block are free built-in protection tools that identify and help stop likely
  scammers before you ever get the call. Here’s how:****
  * Scam ID warns you when a call is suspected to be an illegal scam call by replacing the Caller ID
    display with the words “Scam Likely”. Plus, because T-Mobile is able to look beyond the incoming
    number and tracks actual call behavior, Scam ID can catch spoofed calls as well.
  * If you don’t want to see any “Scam Likely” calls, you can activate Scam Block for free by simply
    dialing #662# on your T-Mobile phone.
* ### How do I block a scam call? I’m a T-Mobile prepaid customer.
  
  To turn on Scam Block, dial #662# from your T-Mobile phone. To turn it off, dial #632#. To check
  whether Scam Block is on or off, dial #787#.

## FAQs
* ### What happens if I switch plans mid-cycle?
  
  You can switch between different types of mobile plans, like talk and text plans or data plans.
  Here's what you need to know:
  * You can only make one plan change at a time. If you need to change your start date, you'll have
    to do a separate request.
  * You can start your new plan right away or wait until your next billing cycle.
  * You don't need money in your account to change plans, but you won't be able to use your service
    if your account is unpaid.
  * Your plan change will be recorded in your account automatically.
  * If you switch to a plan that doesn't work with your data storage, you'll see warnings about
    losing that saved data.
* ### Can I bring my own phone to use with T-Mobile Prepaid?
  
  Yes, devices must be unlocked by the original carrier or OEM and be compatible with the network
  for them to be used on T-Mobile's network. Some T-Mobile services may not be available or may
  require additional set up to function properly.
  More info here: [https://prepaid.t-mobile.com/bring-your-own-device][56]
* ### Is mobile hotspot included or available as an add-on?

  you exceed your data limit, your data speeds will be reduced to 3G speeds. To access more data,
  you can upgrade your plan by contacting 611 or visiting a T-Mobile store.
* ### What if I’m calling Mexico or Canada exclusively?

  U.S., Mexico and Canada while on our network or roaming with a partner. Plus get unlimited texting
  to 215+ countries and destinations, and up to 5GB of high-speed data (or a maximum of your plan’s
  high-speed data allotment, whichever comes first) while in a coverage area in Mexico or Canada.
  The More Monthly plan includes Unlimited talk and text to Mexico & Canada from the U.S., Mexico,
  and Canada, and Unlimited text to 215+ countries and destinations from the U.S.
* ### How will I be charged for international calling to pay-per-minute countries?

  available account balance. You will need to have funds in your account in order to complete
  pay-per-minute calls.****
* ### Who is eligible for Caller ID?
  
  All T-Mobile prepaid customers with a capable device on voice plans are eligible for free Caller
  ID.
* ### How much does Caller ID cost?
  
  Caller ID is available to T-Mobile prepaid voice customers at no extra charge.
* ### How do I get Scam ID?
  
  Scam ID is free and automatic for all T-Mobile prepaid customers on a capable device; no action
  required.
* ### How do I activate a T-Mobile Prepaid SIM card?
  
  For detail step by step click here:
  
  [https://www.t-mobile.com/support/devices/sim-esim][57]

  Block services and free incoming Caller ID.
  Scam ID identifies bad actors and shows as Scam Likely on devices, but it doesn't show blocked or
  unknown caller details.
  All calls from identified scammers (such as Scam Likely numbers) are blocked in the network and
  disconnected before your phone rings when Scam Block is enabled.

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

TANGAN IBU MEDIS reflects our belief that healthcare should be as comforting and reassuring as a

About Us

## Established in 2019

Founded in 2019, our company has grown through providing import and export agency services in
Indonesia for medical devices, cosmetic ingredients, and beauty products. Since 2025, we have been
focusing on our medical device business and have been expanding it through the establishment and
operation of PT Tangan Ibu Medis (PT TIM), a specialized medical device distribution company.

We hold the exclusive distribution rights in Indonesia for the following FDA-certified medical
devices:
* **HiCardi+ H100** — Holter Monitor, South Korea
* **HiCardi+** — Real-Time Remote Patient Monitoring System, South Korea
* **AiRTouch 905** — Portable X-Ray System, USA

In addition to supplying medical devices, we provide end-to-end support services, including
installation, user training, technical assistance, and after-sales support to ensure optimal
performance and long-term reliability.

In partnership with

[Kemenkes — RSJPD Harapan Kita]

In November 2025, PT Tangan Ibu Medis signed a 10-year joint operation agreement with RSJPD Harapan
Kita, Indonesia’s National Cardiovascular Center in West Jakarta, to establish a dedicated HiCardi+
H100 Holter Interpretation Center serving patients across Indonesia, including BPJS beneficiaries.

### Wireless Wearable ECG Business

#### a. HiCardi+ H100

A wearable wireless Holter monitor that overcomes the limitations of conventional wired Holter
devices and records continuous ECG data for up to 72 hours. Applicable for Holter monitoring and for
patients with confirmed or suspected arrhythmia.

#### b. HiCardi+

A digital cardiac monitoring platform that measures, transmits, and monitors patient vital signals
in real time — usable not only for inpatient monitoring but also for post-discharge home care.

Applications

units, real-time ambulance monitoring, and home remote monitoring (telehealth capable).

A lightweight mobile X-ray system equipped with a high-performance digital detector and built-in PC.
Manufactured by LIVERMORETECH INC, USA.

Applications

Mobile imaging within hospitals, ambulances, home visits, remote healthcare settings, and
large-scale screening programs. Participating in mobile screening projects aligned with the

  ## iWAREHOUSE Integrated Tether System
  
  Designed to reinforce best practices – and the industry’s first integrated wireless solution with
  truck slow-down functionality and reporting – the iWAREHOUSE Integrated tether system limits truck
  operation if a proper connection is not detected between a self-retracting lanyard (SRL) and an
  operator’s harness.
  [Learn More About Integrated Tether][176]

  ## Calculate Your Cost Savings by Switching to Lithium-Ion
  
  Our line of lithium-ion batteries, compatible with our family of forklifts, showcases our
  dedication to advancement. These batteries are designed to seamlessly integrate into your lift
  trucks providing advanced data insights and wireless communication for remote diagnostics and
  upgrades.

  switching to Lithium-ion batteries within your current fleet.

suspicious communication such as phishing messages or fake financial service calls.

## **TAFCOP Consumer Portal – Benefits for Users**

The TAFCOP Consumer Portal helps users monitor and secure their telecom accounts. Some key benefits
include:
* Easy access to all active SIMs under your name
* Option to report and block unknown or inactive numbers
* SMS alerts when a new SIM is issued under your identity
* A complaint tracking system to follow up on fraud reports

The TAFCOP mobile number check feature ensures no one misuses your identity to obtain extra SIM
cards without consent.

## **Sanchar Saathi and Data Privacy Concerns**

While the Sanchar Saathi App strengthens user safety, there are also concerns about data privacy and
protection. As the platform stores IMEI numbers, mobile identities, and telecom data, questions
arise about how securely this information is managed.

**Some experts believe the app should include:**
* Clear guidelines on how long user data is stored
* Stronger encryption to prevent unauthorized access
* Transparent policies about who can view or use stored data
* Strict penalties for misuse of personal information

To maintain user trust, the DoT is expected to release a comprehensive privacy framework that
defines how Sanchar Saathi and TAFCOP data will be handled.

## **Impact of Sanchar Saathi Portal on Telecom Security**

The Sanchar Saathi TAFCOP initiative has significantly improved transparency in the telecom sector.
It allows citizens to directly control and verify their digital identity, reducing the risk of SIM
cloning, fake activations, and identity theft.

Telecom operators are also required to update their systems regularly to align with Sanchar Saathi’s
security standards. This results in better tracking of user activity, fewer spam calls, and a more
accountable network.

## **Way Forward**

Going forward, the Sanchar Saathi Portal and App can be made even more effective by:
* Expanding awareness about its features through digital literacy campaigns
* Encouraging telecom companies and phone makers to integrate it deeply into devices
* Ensuring better coordination with law enforcement for stolen phone recovery
* Introducing multilingual support for rural and regional users

With consistent updates, the Sanchar Saathi and TAFCOP Sancharsaathi platforms can play a vital role
in achieving a safer digital ecosystem in India.

> **Note:** Beware of apps playing on mobile the **[Jalwa][31]** & **[Tiranga][32]**. Always play
> responsibly and be aware of potential risks before engaging in online gaming platforms.

## **FAQs on Sanchar Saathi Portal**

#### Q1. What is the Sanchar Saathi Portal?

It is a DoT initiative that allows users to verify SIM cards, block lost phones, and check IMEI
authenticity online.

#### Q2. How can I check SIM cards linked to my Aadhaar?

Visit tafcop.sancharsaathi.gov.in, enter your mobile number, verify OTP, and view all linked
numbers.

#### Q3. What is the role of CEIR in Sanchar Saathi?

The Central Equipment Identity Register helps block or trace stolen mobile devices using their IMEI
numbers.

#### Q4. Can I download the Sanchar Saathi App?

Yes, it is available on Google Play Store and soon on Apple App Store.

#### Q5. Is Sanchar Saathi safe to use?

Yes, it is developed by the Department of Telecommunications, though users should stay aware of
privacy settings and permissions.

## Faqs

What medical equipment does Sasha HealthCare supply?

Sasha HealthCare supplies a wide range of refurbished and pre-owned medical equipment, including
**CT scan machines, MRI machines, Cath Lab systems, Digital X-ray machines, PET-CT** scanners,
mammography machines, C-Arms, and other diagnostic imaging equipment. We provide cost-effective
solutions for hospitals, diagnostic centers, and healthcare institutions across India.

Are refurbished CT and MRI machines reliable?

**Yes.** Our **refurbished CT scan and MRI machines** go through a strict refurbishment process
including inspection, replacement of worn components, calibration, and quality testing. This ensures
the machines perform with **high accuracy, reliability, and long-term stability** similar to new
systems.

Do you provide installation and de-installation services?

Yes. Sasha HealthCare offers **complete installation and de-installation services** for medical
imaging equipment such as **CT scanners, MRI machines, Cath Labs, and X-ray systems**. Our
experienced engineers ensure proper setup, calibration, and operational testing.

Do you provide maintenance and repair services for medical equipment?

Yes. We provide **comprehensive maintenance, breakdown repair, and AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract)
services** for diagnostic imaging equipment including **CT scan machines, MRI scanners, Cath Labs,
Digital X-ray systems, and other hospital equipment**.

What is the price of refurbished CT scan and MRI machines?

The price of **refurbished CT scan and MRI machines** depends on factors such as brand, model, slice
capacity, and system configuration. Refurbished systems can cost **30–50% less than new machines**,
making them an affordable solution for hospitals and diagnostic centers.

Which brands of medical equipment do you offer?

Sasha HealthCare provides refurbished equipment from leading global brands such as **Siemens, GE
Healthcare, Philips, and Canon**. These brands are known for their **advanced imaging technology,
reliability, and diagnostic accuracy**.

How can I contact Sasha HealthCare for medical equipment inquiries?

You can contact Sasha HealthCare for **product inquiries, pricing, installation services, or
technical support** through the following:

📞 Phone / WhatsApp: **+91 8009699599**
📧 Email: **info@sashahealthcare.com**

Our team will assist you in choosing the **right CT, MRI, Cath Lab, or diagnostic equipment** for
your healthcare facility.

## Faqs

What medical equipment does Sasha HealthCare supply?

Sasha HealthCare supplies a wide range of refurbished and pre-owned medical equipment, including
**CT scan machines, MRI machines, Cath Lab systems, Digital X-ray machines, PET-CT** scanners,
mammography machines, C-Arms, and other diagnostic imaging equipment. We provide cost-effective
solutions for hospitals, diagnostic centers, and healthcare institutions across India.

Are refurbished CT and MRI machines reliable?

**Yes.** Our **refurbished CT scan and MRI machines** go through a strict refurbishment process
including inspection, replacement of worn components, calibration, and quality testing. This ensures
the machines perform with **high accuracy, reliability, and long-term stability** similar to new
systems.

Do you provide installation and de-installation services?

Yes. Sasha HealthCare offers **complete installation and de-installation services** for medical
imaging equipment such as **CT scanners, MRI machines, Cath Labs, and X-ray systems**. Our
experienced engineers ensure proper setup, calibration, and operational testing.

Do you provide maintenance and repair services for medical equipment?

Yes. We provide **comprehensive maintenance, breakdown repair, and AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract)
services** for diagnostic imaging equipment including **CT scan machines, MRI scanners, Cath Labs,
Digital X-ray systems, and other hospital equipment**.

What is the price of refurbished CT scan and MRI machines?

The price of **refurbished CT scan and MRI machines** depends on factors such as brand, model, slice
capacity, and system configuration. Refurbished systems can cost **30–50% less than new machines**,
making them an affordable solution for hospitals and diagnostic centers.

Which brands of medical equipment do you offer?

Sasha HealthCare provides refurbished equipment from leading global brands such as **Siemens, GE
Healthcare, Philips, and Canon**. These brands are known for their **advanced imaging technology,
reliability, and diagnostic accuracy**.

How can I contact Sasha HealthCare for medical equipment inquiries?

You can contact Sasha HealthCare for **product inquiries, pricing, installation services, or
technical support** through the following:

📞 Phone / WhatsApp: **+91 8009699599**
📧 Email: **info@sashahealthcare.com**

Our team will assist you in choosing the **right CT, MRI, Cath Lab, or diagnostic equipment** for
your healthcare facility.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are the most widely used MRI contrast agents on the market?

The most widely used MRI contrast agents are Dotarem, Elucirem, Clariscan, Multihance, Prohance,
Vueway, Gadovist, and Gadobutrol.

What are the most recent MRI contrast agents, and what are their benefits?

Elucirem by Guerbet and Vueway by Bracco are next-generation GBCAs (Gadolinium-Based Contrast
Agents) that have recently entered the market. Their primary benefit is the use of 50% less
gadolinium.

What are the most widely used CT contrast agents on the market?

The most commonly used CT contrast agents include Isovue by Bracco, Optiray by Guerbet, and
Omnipaque by GE.

Who are the major manufacturers of contrast power injectors?

The leading manufacturers of contrast power injectors are Medrad, Guerbet, and Bracco.

Which company manufactures both power injectors and compatible prefilled contrast syringes?

gadolinium.

Omnipaque by GE.

# Nationwide Diagnostics.
# **Delivered With
# Local Precision.**

Trusted care starts with access. We provide high-quality **digital X-Ray**, **ultrasound**, **EKG**,
**laboratory** and **PICC insertion** services wherever patients reside, gather or work.

[ Order Services ][54]
[ Learn More ][55]

## Why TridentCare?

### Nationwide Reach, Local Expertise

Serving patients across the country with highly trained, fully licensed clinical teams operating at
the local level.

### One Partner. Multiple Solutions.

Imaging, laboratory, and vascular services—all delivered by a single trusted provider and a single
source of quality reporting.

### Certified, Licensed, and Accredited

Strict compliance standards across every state. Licensed technologists, certified radiologists, and
credentialed laboratory professionals ensure consistent quality of care.

### Technology-Enabled Simplicity

With over 5,000 customer locations connected via bi-directional EMR interfaces, TridentConnect
streamlines the entire diagnostic workflow. It reduces paperwork, improves accuracy, and keeps care
teams connected in real time.

### Continuity You Can Count On

Scalable resources allow us to respond rapidly when patient needs change, minimizing care
disruption.

## Standards That Set Us Apart

At TridentCare, we go beyond industry requirements to deliver quality at every level. Our ultrasound
services are ACR-accredited in general, vascular, and mammography, with IAC recognition in
echocardiography—a distinction few pursue. Clinicians are certified by ARDMS, ARRT, or CCI and
licensed in every applicable state. Our national lab network is CLIA-certified, with additional
accreditations from CAP and COLA. And our Imaging, Lab, and Integration platforms are HITRUST e1
certified, ensuring patient data is protected through leading-edge security.

 

Quality care means safeguarding both the patient and the process.

nursing environments.

# Nationwide Diagnostics.
# **Delivered With
# Local Precision.**

Trusted care starts with access. We provide high-quality **digital X-Ray**, **ultrasound**, **EKG**,
**laboratory** and **PICC insertion** services wherever patients reside, gather or work.

[ Order Services ][54]
[ Learn More ][55]

## Why TridentCare?

### Nationwide Reach, Local Expertise

Serving patients across the country with highly trained, fully licensed clinical teams operating at
the local level.

### One Partner. Multiple Solutions.

Imaging, laboratory, and vascular services—all delivered by a single trusted provider and a single
source of quality reporting.

### Certified, Licensed, and Accredited

Strict compliance standards across every state. Licensed technologists, certified radiologists, and
credentialed laboratory professionals ensure consistent quality of care.

### Technology-Enabled Simplicity

With over 5,000 customer locations connected via bi-directional EMR interfaces, TridentConnect
streamlines the entire diagnostic workflow. It reduces paperwork, improves accuracy, and keeps care
teams connected in real time.

### Continuity You Can Count On

Scalable resources allow us to respond rapidly when patient needs change, minimizing care
disruption.

## Standards That Set Us Apart

At TridentCare, we go beyond industry requirements to deliver quality at every level. Our ultrasound
services are ACR-accredited in general, vascular, and mammography, with IAC recognition in
echocardiography—a distinction few pursue. Clinicians are certified by ARDMS, ARRT, or CCI and
licensed in every applicable state. Our national lab network is CLIA-certified, with additional
accreditations from CAP and COLA. And our Imaging, Lab, and Integration platforms are HITRUST e1
certified, ensuring patient data is protected through leading-edge security.

 

Quality care means safeguarding both the patient and the process.

[tridentcare history]

## We Serve Healthcare Providers and Patients Across Multiple Settings:

[
Delivering on-site diagnostics that reduce patient transport and support care continuity in skilled
nursing environments.

patients.

Empowering care teams to diagnose and monitor patients from the comfort of their homes, minimizing
unnecessary ER visits.

[
Trusted diagnostics for federal, state, and local agencies—built for mission-critical reliability
and rapid deployment.

Providing secure, compliant diagnostic services in challenging environments where access and safety
are critical.
Learn More
][64]
[Behavioral Health & Correctional Facilities][65]
[
Scalable diagnostic solutions for both the private and public sectors across the nation.
Learn More
